title: Members
description: Everyone who has booked a desk in your space, plus prospects on a Flex pack.
searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email, or phone…

empty.title: No members yet
empty.description: Members are created automatically when you book a desk, or you can add them here.
empty.noMatchDescription: Clear the filters, or invite someone new.

nudges.contractsEndingBodySingle: {{name}} is up. A quick nudge today usually pulls a renewal.
nudges.contractsEndingBodyMultiple: {{names}}{{more}}. Reach out before they decide for themselves.
nudges.missingContactBody: Add an email or phone so renewals, invoices, and door PINs land where the member can see them.
nudges.portalDiscoveryBody: Members can log in to a portal to see their plan, balance, next bill and invoices. Invite anyone from their card — open a member and tap "Create access link".

row.frozenTitle: Membership frozen — {{days}} unused day saved. Click Reactivate to resume their plan from where it paused.
row.frozenTitle_plural: Membership frozen — {{days}} unused days saved. Click Reactivate to resume their plan from where it paused.

overview.resumePlanTitle: {{days}} banked day — resume the plan from where it paused.
overview.resumePlanTitle_plural: {{days}} banked days — resume the plan from where it paused.
overview.clearFlexDescription: Removes this member's flex plan{{daysPart}}. They will show as having no flex pack. Existing flex-marked desk bookings stay on the calendar but no longer consume a balance.

repriceDialog.title: Apply the new price now, or only later?
repriceDialog.description: {{name}} has an active plan whose stored price would change:

billing.autoGenerateOn: When on, this member is included in the monthly batch run.
billing.autoGenerateOff: Add billing name + address (Overview → billing requisites) to enable.

activateForm.flexDescription: {{name}} will get {{count}} days of flex access starting today.

meetingHours.description: A prepaid hour balance for meeting rooms — burns down as {{name}} books, at whatever price you set below.
meetingHours.label: Label

hotdesk.activeMemberships: {{active}} active hotdesk membership · {{desks}} desks in this space
hotdesk.activeMemberships_plural: {{active}} active hotdesk memberships · {{desks}} desks in this space
hotdesk.capacityWarning: Activating this membership brings hotdesk demand to {{after}} of {{total}} desks — at or above the {{threshold}}% planning threshold. You can still activate it.

dedicated.ongoingDesc: A rolling / month-to-month contract that renews each month until you end it. Leave unticked for a fixed term ending {{date}}.
dedicated.noPrice: No price set for this plan

alerts.deleteDesc: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}? This will unlink them from any bookings.
alerts.deleteSharedProfilesNote: Their shared billing profiles will be transferred before the member is removed.
alerts.flexActivatedDesc: Share this personal booking link with the member. They can use it to self-book and their balance will be tracked automatically.
alerts.activateFlexDesc: Activate flex plan for "{{name}}"? They will get {{days}} days starting today.
alerts.resetFlexDesc: Reset the flex plan for "{{name}}"? This will start a new {{days}}-day plan.

toasts.pricingGroupRepriced: Pricing group updated and current price re-applied.
toasts.autoInvoiceOnDesc: {{name}} will be included in the monthly batch.

profile.title: Billing details
profile.listDesc: Each profile can be picked as "Bill to" when raising an invoice.
profile.primaryDesc: Prefills every invoice for this member.
profile.billingNameHelp: The name printed on invoices. Leave blank to use the member's name.
profile.autoInvoiceDesc: When on, this member's recurring plans are drafted in the monthly batch run. You can still send or void manually any time.
profile.autoInvoiceRequired: Add a billing name and address above to enable.

billingProfiles.heading: Additional billing profiles
billingProfiles.headingDesc: Bill some of this member's plans to another entity (e.g. their company). You pick the profile as "Bill to" when raising an invoice — their own details above stay the default.
billingProfiles.combineAutoInvoices: Combine linked members into one auto-invoice
billingProfiles.combineAutoInvoicesHelp: Off keeps one invoice per member. Manual invoices are unchanged.
billingProfiles.transferDescription: {{label}} is used by {{names}}. It will stay linked to their plans.
billingProfiles.removeDescription: Remove {{label}}? Plans using it will return to the member’s personal billing details.
billingProfiles.noOtherProfiles: No other billing profiles in this organization yet.
billingProfiles.clearPersonalPromoteDesc: {{label}} becomes this member's personal billing profile.
billingProfiles.clearPersonalDesc: This clears the member's personal billing details.
billingProfiles.clearPersonalOwnershipNotice: {{label}} is also used by {{names}}, so ownership must move first.

planTargets.separateInvoices: Select another member’s profile to share the same payer. By default each member still receives a separate invoice.

portal.heading: Member portal access
portal.description: Send {{name}} a link to view their plan, balance and invoices. They sign in with Google or email.

authCard.confirmEmailNotice: Check your email to confirm your account, then come back and sign in.
authCard.accountExists: You already have an account with this email — switch to Sign in.

subscriptionCard.pastDueDesc: The last charge did not go through. Update your card so the next period can be booked.
subscriptionCard.cancellingDesc: Access stays until {{date}}. Nothing is charged after that.
subscriptionCard.renewsOnDesc: Renews on {{date}}. Turn off renewal any time — this period still finishes.
subscriptionCard.turnedOffToastDesc: Your pass stays valid until the end of this period.
subscriptionCard.turnedOffWithDateToastDesc: Your pass stays valid until {{date}}. No refund for days already paid.
subscriptionCard.resumedToastDesc: The next period will be charged automatically.
subscriptionCard.updateErrorDesc: Please try again or contact the space.

login.title: Member sign in
login.subtitle: Access your plan, balance and invoices.

home.title: My memberships
home.errorLoading: Couldn't load your memberships. Please refresh and try again.
home.emptyDesc: Ask your coworking space to send you a portal access link. Once you open it and sign in here, your plan and invoices will show up on this page.

claim.invalidDesc: It may have expired or already been used. Ask the team to send you a fresh access link.
claim.title: Access your {{space}} account
claim.setupSubtitle: Set up your login to see your plan, balance and invoices.
claim.expiredError: This link has just expired or was already used. Ask the space for a fresh one.

dashboard.contactForInvoice: To settle an invoice, contact your space.
dashboard.stripeSecure: Payments are processed securely by Stripe.

invites.title: Invite a member to sign up
invites.description: Create a single-use link and send it to a prospect. They fill in their own details, and the sign-up lands in your review queue to approve.
invites.noActive: No active links. Create one above.
invites.createdToastDesc: Copied to your clipboard — send it to the new member.

pendingSubmissions.title: Pending sign-ups
pendingSubmissions.description: People who filled in your invite link. Approve to add them as a member, or dismiss.
pendingSubmissions.nothingWaitingDesc: New sign-ups from your invite links show up here.
pendingSubmissions.approvedToastDesc: {{name}} is now in your members list.

csvImport.title: Import members from CSV
csvImport.uploadDesc: Drop a CSV file or paste its contents below.
csvImport.mapDesc: Confirm column mapping and review rows before importing.
csvImport.limitNote: Up to {{count}} rows. Comma, semicolon, or tab delimited.
csvImport.tooManyRows: File has {{count}} rows. Only the first {{limit}} will be imported. Split the file to import the rest.

stripe.title: Stripe Subscription
stripe.autoRenewOff: Auto-renew is off. Member retains access until <1>{{date}}</1>.
stripe.pastDue: The last renewal payment could not be processed. Card needs updating.
stripe.canceledDesc: Subscription has ended and will not renew.
stripe.cancelToastDesc: Access remains active until {{date}}. No further charges will occur.
stripe.resumeToastDesc: The subscription will automatically renew at the end of the current period.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {{name}}'s plan
reactivate.bankedNote: <1>{{count}}</1> day banked from the paused plan. They'll be placed day-by-day, swapping desks if needed to keep the plan contiguous.
reactivate.bankedNote_plural: <1>{{count}}</1> days banked from the paused plan. They'll be placed day-by-day, swapping desks if needed to keep the plan contiguous.
